day_shape: 64 items: US-Iran 14-point MoU signed with Witkoff and Kushner heading to Switzerland for 60-day nuclear talks, IDF claims 150+ Hezbollah targets struck and a 4pm ceasefire after four soldiers killed at Kfar Tebnit, Khamenei sets conditions, UN OCHA three-month impact report published.

threads.label: US-Iran MoU and Switzerland talks
threads.summary: Reports said US envoy Steve Witkoff was travelling to Switzerland to join Jared Kushner for the first of a 60-day series of US-Iran nuclear talks following the 14-point memorandum of understanding. Trump defended the MoU as superior to the 2015 JCPOA, while Obama warned the US could be 'worse off', Senator Tom Cotton estimated sanctions relief at $200m/day, and UN experts said any final deal omitting human rights would be 'fundamentally incomplete'.

threads.label: Khamenei conditions message debated in Tehran
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that Iran would 'await fulfilment of the stated conditions' and that future face-to-face negotiations would 'not mean accepting the enemy's viewpoint'. Iran International reported hardliners and moderates in Tehran offering sharply different interpretations of the message, and Iranian FM Araghchi said the US bears responsibility to uphold a ceasefire on all fronts while denying Iran had invited the IAEA into previously barred sites.

threads.label: Lebanon strikes and 4pm ceasefire
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck over 150 Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon and the Beqaa since midnight, killing dozens of operatives, after four IDF soldiers were killed and five wounded at Kfar Tebnit; a senior US official told Reuters Israel and Hezbollah agreed a ceasefire from 4pm. Defence Minister Katz said the IDF would remain in the security zone, Hezbollah's Naim Qassem issued a defiant speech, and IRIB reported four killed in a strike on Baris village.

threads.label: Lebanon diplomacy and humanitarian response
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio called Lebanese President Aoun to reaffirm US support for Lebanese sovereignty, and UK Development Minister Jenny Chapman visited Lebanon with French and Qatari counterparts to announce new humanitarian support. UN OCHA published its three-month Middle East Emergency impact report covering March-May 2026, and the ICRC delivered over 18 tonnes of supplies to the Iranian Red Crescent.

threads.label: Sharif University expulsions
threads.summary: Iran International reported Sharif University of Technology issued preliminary expulsion orders for seven students, citing the United Students group and describing it as part of postwar tightening of social control. IRIB confirmed the disciplinary committee condemned six students to expulsion over the Esfand unrest, naming Sepanta Saidi, Hossein Shadman and Masihya Bagh among them.

threads.label: Iran domestic economy and energy strain
threads.summary: Tehran Province Electricity Distribution Company announced it had cut power to 30 high-consumption state agencies at the start of the peak period, and Iran International reported on the Iran-Qatar electricity grid plan against the backdrop of severe domestic shortages. IRIB said the Tehran Stock Exchange main index rose 89,000 points to 5,240,000, and Iran International argued an MoU alone would not rescue the oil economy.

threads.label: Pakistan diplomacy and border violence
threads.summary: IRIB reported Pakistani Interior Minister Syed Mohsin Raza Naqvi had departed for Tehran to meet senior Iranian officials and follow up on Iran-US negotiations. IRIB also reported two bomb explosions in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa in north-west Pakistan killed seven civilians, with no group claiming responsibility.

events.title_en: Dismissal orders issued for six who insulted Iranian flag at Sharif University
events.summary_en: The disciplinary committee of Sharif University of Technology, in separate preliminary rulings, has condemned six students to expulsion from the university for their role in the unrest of Esfand, organising and directing illegal gatherings, insults, activities against the system and other disciplinary violations. Among those subject to these rulings are Sepanta Saidi, Hossein Shadman, Masihya Bagheri, Fateme Khakpour, Fariborz Kohanzad and Parnian Khodabakhshi. Some of these rulings, in addition to expulsion, include a ban of several years from continuing studies.

events.title_en: Life returns to Lake Urmia
events.summary_en: With an eighteen-fold increase in the volume of water in Lake Urmia, Artemia has flourished again and flamingos have once more returned to this ecosystem. It is expected that more than six thousand flamingos will land in Lake Urmia and the surrounding wetlands this year; some have even begun nesting and breeding. The restoration of Kanibrazzan and Noruzlo wetlands has also created suitable conditions for the presence of migratory birds.

events.title_en: How many like you this world is missing, thank you noble lady, thank you free lady
events.summary_en:
How many like you this world is missing, thank you noble lady, thank you free lady. True freedom is having the courage to take a stance based on awareness, belief and culture, not to walk behind a herd living in blind dependence. When we speak of a principle, we are speaking of intellectual depth and a conscious reading of reality, not merely fleeting emotions.
It is very unfortunate that some cannot accept difference or see matters through a mature cultural perspective, so they resort to shallow analogies trying to diminish the other. Your respect for yourself and your belief prevented you from descending to the level of superficial bickering; for those with firm principles are not shaken by passing words, so greetings to you and may God increase your like

events.title_en: Imminent and fundamental change in the global financial system
events.summary_en: China is in the final stages of preparation to commercially launch the mBridge digital payment system which could fundamentally alter the structure of international transactions. Developments in West Asia have once again raised the necessity of breaking away from the Western financial system among independent nations. China is prepared to commercially launch a new digital payment system to compete with the dollar. This could fundamentally change the structure of commercial transactions. West Asian nations have supported this new system which is called mBridge. China is finalising preparations to commercially launch the digital payment system

events.title_en: People: a power beyond executive organs in the arena of revolution and national security
events.summary_en: If the people do not have a presence in support of Iran's Islamic system on the scene, none of the various organs would have the necessary effectiveness. In Bahman 1357, when Imam Khomeini arrived in Tehran and delivered his first speech on the 12th of Bahman of that year near the graves of the martyrs of Iran's Islamic revolution, he expressed the historic phrase to the government of the time, Shapour Bakhtiar's government: 'I will punch you in the mouth of this government. I will establish government with the support of this nation', a phrase which shows how important the status and power of the people are.
